style_rules: Create exactly one vertical 1440x1920 PNG in a premium Vietnamese corporate HR infographic style.
No logo, no company-name mark, no tagline and no slogan anywhere in the image.
Use fresh bright green as the primary positive accent with deep navy, professional blue, restrained gold, white/light-blue surfaces, and red only for missing/error states.
Use a clean vector business header with pale green/light-blue gradients, subtle abstract growth geometry, generous white space and neutral business icons; do not use people or office photography.
Keep the information order fixed: title/date/update time; four KPI cards; confirmed-hours strip; chart plus overview; exact 8-row detail table; reconciliation footer.
All employee names, dates, times, durations, statuses, KPIs and session strings must come only from the validated report.
Never infer, recalculate, paraphrase or fabricate attendance values inside the visual layer.
Missing values display exactly as an em dash.
Show all 8 employees exactly once in the validated order.
Charts must visually match exact validated durations; missing rows receive no positive bar.
Typography must remain crisp and readable on Teams mobile and desktop.
The final publication image must pass exact-data QA before Teams posting.
